basis: Gonadal failure and skeletal abnormalities define; hearing impairment and specific learning disability each annotated 30-79%; thyroiditis and steatosis are separate diagnoses.
Fibroblastic sarcoma arising in soft connective tissue; collagen rosettes define this histologic variant.
Developmental disability, skeletal and hair/nail abnormalities define Coffin-Siris syndrome; hearing loss 3/4; visual impairment 2/3 and cleft palate 2/4 omitted by cap.
COL6A2-related skeletal myopathy with muscle fiber degeneration, weakness and joint contractures; no peripheral nerve disease demonstrated.
Fusion-defined mesenchymal sarcoma, typically arising in soft connective tissue; no additional organ involvement established.
Combined immunodeficiency, pancytopenia and microcephaly/developmental impairment define LIG4 syndrome; photosensitivity alone does not establish skin injury.
Abnormal bone remodeling within the otic capsule causes stapes fixation or cochlear dysfunction; localized ear disease.
Localized immune-complex small-vessel vasculitis, classically producing inflammation and possible necrosis at a cutaneous injection site.
Neurodevelopmental, metaphyseal and optic nerve defects define; GI telangiectasia/bleeding reported in 1/2 (50%); cutaneous vascular abnormalities omitted by cap.
Autoimmune inflammation directly injures myocardium; dyspnea and edema do not establish separate pulmonary or renal damage.
Hypothalamic hamartoma, pituitary dysfunction and polydactyly define; anal atresia 30-79%; airway, ocular, otologic, renal and nail anomalies omitted by cap.
Congenital cutaneous vascular malformation; supplied HPO annotates limb hypoplasia and seizures at 80-99%; retinal detachment at 30-79% omitted by cap.
Bone fragility and dentinogenesis imperfecta are defining features; hearing loss frequency is not established here; scleral coloration does not impair vision.
Male reproductive infertility; possible hormonal or systemic causes do not establish an endocrine or other axis across this umbrella concept.
Hereditary neuropathy is defining; paraprotein detection alone does not establish blood-cell disease, renal injury or an immune-mediated mechanism.
Carcinoma originates in oropharyngeal epithelium; the pharynx belongs to the pulmonary axis under the specified mapping.
ELP2-related intellectual and motor neurodevelopmental disorder; cardiac and ocular abnormalities occur in some individuals without evidence of a frequency above 30%.
Developmental abnormality of intestinal enteric ganglia produces colonic dysmotility; both bowel and its intrinsic peripheral nervous system define the disease.
Acute middle-ear disease with thick mucoid effusion; infection or an allergic mechanism is not established across the concept.
Recurrent joint effusions, usually involving the knee; an autoimmune or autoinflammatory mechanism is not sufficiently established to add the immune axis.
Inherited heme synthesis defect with characteristic neonatal hemolytic anemia; damaging skin involvement has uncertain frequency; hemolytic jaundice does not establish liver injury.
Unilateral loss of labyrinthine vestibular responsiveness is dysfunction of the inner ear.
Fasciolopsis buski infection directly occupies and can injure the small bowel; no additional commonly damaged organ established.
FAN1-related tubulointerstitial nephritis and fibrosis; hepatic injury supported by elevated transaminases in 5/9 (~56%); inherited nephritis does not imply autoimmunity.
Avulavirus infection defines the concept; transient conjunctivitis in human infection does not establish lasting ocular damage.
